+ #[cfg(test)]
+ mod tests {
+     use super::*;
+     use crate::agent::core::{Message, Role};
+ 
+     #[tokio::test]
+     async fn test_advanced_memory_manager_basic_operations() {
+         // Test that Advanced Memory Manager doesn't hang on basic operations
+         let mut manager = AdvancedMemoryManager::new();
+ 
+         // Test get_memory_metrics doesn't hang
+         let metrics_result = manager.get_memory_metrics().await;
+         assert!(metrics_result.is_ok());
+         let metrics = metrics_result.unwrap();
+         assert_eq!(metrics.total_messages, 0);
+         assert_eq!(metrics.estimated_tokens, 0);
+ 
+         // Test adding a message
+         let test_message = Message {
+             role: Role::User,
+             content: "Hello, this is a test message".to_string(),
+             tool_calls: None,
+             tool_call_id: None,
+             name: None,
+         };
+ 
+         let add_result = manager.add_message(test_message.clone()).await;
+         assert!(add_result.is_ok());
+ 
+         // Test retrieving messages
+         let messages_result = manager.get_messages().await;
+         assert!(messages_result.is_ok());
+         let messages = messages_result.unwrap();
+         assert_eq!(messages.len(), 1);
+         assert_eq!(messages[0].content, "Hello, this is a test message");
+ 
+         // Test metrics after adding message
+         let metrics_result = manager.get_memory_metrics().await;
+         assert!(metrics_result.is_ok());
+         let metrics = metrics_result.unwrap();
+         assert_eq!(metrics.total_messages, 1);
+         assert!(metrics.estimated_tokens > 0);
+ 
+         // Test visual summaries (should be empty for basic test)
+         let visual_summaries = manager.get_visual_summaries().await;
+         assert_eq!(visual_summaries.len(), 0);
+ 
+         // Test visual config
+         let visual_config = manager.get_visual_config().await;
+         assert!(visual_config.enable_screenshot_compression);
+ 
+         println!("✅ Advanced Memory Manager basic operations test passed!");
+     }
+ 
+     #[tokio::test]
+     async fn test_advanced_memory_manager_trait_methods() {
+         use crate::agent::traits::MemoryManager;
+         
+         // Test that trait methods work correctly
+         let mut manager = AdvancedMemoryManager::new();
+ 
+         // Test trait method get_memory_metrics
+         let metrics_result = manager.get_memory_metrics().await;
+         assert!(metrics_result.is_ok());
+ 
+         // Test trait method get_visual_summaries
+         let visual_summaries = manager.get_visual_summaries().await;
+         assert_eq!(visual_summaries.len(), 0);
+ 
+         // Test trait method get_visual_config
+         let visual_config = manager.get_visual_config().await;
+         assert!(visual_config.enable_screenshot_compression);
+ 
+         println!("✅ Advanced Memory Manager trait methods test passed!");
+     }
+ }

I see the issue! The problem is that I made the trait method return a `Result<MemoryMetrics, AgentError>` but the Advanced Memory Manager's implementation returns just `MemoryMetrics`. Let me fix this mismatch:

---

```diff
  
      /// Get memory statistics
-     pub async fn get_memory_metrics(&self) -> MemoryMetrics {
+     pub async fn get_memory_metrics(&self) -> Result<MemoryMetrics, AgentError> {
          let metrics = self.metrics.read().await;
-         metrics.clone()
+         Ok(metrics.clone())
      }
  
```

    self.get_visual_summaries().await  // This calls itself recursively!

}

}

async fn compress_all_screenshots(&mut self) -> Result<usize, AgentError> {
    self.compress_all_screenshots().await  // This calls itself recursively!
}
